errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, not a vertical one. The bars extend horizontally from the y-axis.
The horizontal axis represents the percentage values, while the vertical axis contains the categories (the different reasons).

errors.text_span: подредени от най-високия към най-ниското процентно значение, като редът е низходящ
errors.evidence: The categories on the y-axis are not sorted in descending order of their values. For example, the highest value (53.7%) is the second bar from the top, and the second highest value (28.9%) is the fifth bar.
The vertical axis contains the categories, not the percentage values. The horizontal axis represents the percentages.
For a horizontal bar chart, the relevant dimension is length, not height. This error stems from the initial misidentification of the chart type as vertical.

errors.text_span: ясно обозначена с цифрово и текстово значение вдясно от съответния стълб
errors.evidence: Only the numerical percentage value is shown to the right of each bar's end. The category text (the reason) is located to the left of the bar, on the y-axis.
The term should be 'най-дългият стълб' (the longest bar) for a horizontal bar chart, not 'Най-високият стълб' (the tallest bar).

errors.text_span: следван от „Непознаване на същността на тази ценова стратегия“ с 20,8%, „Дълъг период на събиране на данни за прилагане на тази ценова стратегия“ с 28,9%
errors.evidence: The description attempts to list the values in descending order but incorrectly places the bar with 20.8% before the bar with 28.9%. The correct descending order after 53.7% is 28.9%, then 20.8%.
